programme.title: Paul Merton: Driving Amazing Trains
programme.desc: Paul heads to the north of England, traversing the country in the cabs of steam and diesel trains from the Lakes to Whitby. He battles 'leaves on the line' in a narrow-gauge steam loco before switching to steam powered boat on Windermere for a cruise. After experiencing the luxury of Queen Victoria's private carriage, he heads off to drive a fifty-ton wartime steam loco and a historic hand-powered railway cart.

programme.title: Record-breaking Highways
programme.desc: France's motorways are among the most ambitious engineering achievements in the world. The A40 conquers extreme mountain terrain, the Paris ring road transformed an entire capital city, and the A10 stretches an extraordinary 557 kilometres from Paris to Bordeaux. Explore the record-breaking construction feats, breathtaking structures, and ingenious solutions that make these roads truly remarkable.

programme.sub-title: Michael Palin In North Korea Series 1 Ep 1

programme.desc: All the action from Stage 6 of the 2026 Tour Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes (formerly Criterium du Dauphine), as the peloton takes on a 181.4 km route starting in Saint-Vulbas and finishing in Crest-Voland.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Until recently, Portugal’s traditional ewe’s milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programme.desc: The remaining nine bakers must think beyond the bar as they create a nougat-filled chocolate confection in a surprising shape as they vie for the coveted Golden Whisk.

programme.desc: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek learn about the overabundance of sea urchin, and explore a new type of sustainable farming in Berrima. The boys also have a go at bee keeping.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese And Special Sauce
programme.desc: Rachael is cooking up some serious comfort food today and with this much flavour, you'd never guess that these robust bull's eye burgers topped with onions and blue cheese sauce are plant-based.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt teams up with wine connoisseur Adam Walls to complement his specialty Lo Mai Gai. Laura and Chef Jack Ingram create a decadent chocolate plum clafoutis at Jolley's Boathouse in Adelaide, while Mike ventures to Taggerty, Victoria, to prepare wood cooked bananas for a local celebrity.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminds everyone to make the kitchen and recipe work for you. Lidia starts with a one-sheet wonder of Spicy Pork Chops & Broccoli.

programme.title: What Chefs Want
programme.desc: Chef Damian D'Silva uncovers the fascinating history and medicinal properties of Singapore's traditional cuisine. From the healing power of ginger to the time-honoured recipes of Peranakan cuisine.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Mostaccioli owe their name to one of the ingredients they are made with: grape must (mosto). These days, this elusive ingredient has been replaced with a combination of cocoa, spices and vincotto.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight's is all about the glorious tomato, with Guy joining tomato grower John Monigatti on Echuca's black soil plains during harvest. Maeve then shares tomato day with a large Calabrese clan - the Cipri family in suburban Sydney who have made fresh tomato sauce every year since the patriarch Severio arrived in Australia 45 years ago.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: The most sacred food of the Anishinaabe people has become a prized ingredient in the upper Midwest and beyond.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Jake Kellie drops by to make a rustic dish of wild mushrooms and confit baby onions and then Justine makes her carnival fritters and some succulent pork medalions.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.sub-title: Art And Storytelling Of Food, The
programme.desc: Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where culinary masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culminates in art.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight, Guy visits dedicated Melbourne artisan baker Daniel Chirico and tastes bread straight from the oven. Guy then demonstrates a delicious bread-based salad called panzanella. Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: Pears got their start in Oregon back in 1847 when an Iowa native brought the fruit to the region. In 2005, the Oregon legislature named the pear the state fruit.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Justine shows you how to make a classic steak diane and her mixed fettucini with asparagus and egg. Alvin Quah shares his recipe for pork san choy bao.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a night of smokey goodness as Adam, chef Tom Sarafian and comedian Tegan Higginbotham share how they like to savour smokey flavours.

programme.desc: Anna offers two innovative takes on classic meatball dishes: tuna meatballs served with an aioli dipping sauce and eggplant meatballs paired with spicy marinara and topped with ricotta salata.

programme.desc: Deep in Gator Country on the Florida panhandle, Bill and Paul set out to hunt alligators using a crossbow, and cook them up for dinner with the locals.

programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View

programme.title: Gosford Park

The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View

The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

programme.sub-title: Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania
programme.desc: Will journeys to Italy’s picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk. After learning about Italy’s oldest ewe’s milk cheese, which is matured in a terracotta jar, Will gets a lesson from a Countess in how to make the perfect wood-fired pizza. He then heads to the coast to look at cacao Cavallo, a traditional stretched curd cheese made with cow’s milk, before visiting the underground maturation rooms of Casa Madaio where the finest examples are aged.

programme.desc: Paul heads to the north of England, traversing the country in the cabs of steam and diesel trains from the Lakes to Whitby. programme.title: Record-breaking Highways
programme.desc: France's motorways are among the most ambitious engineering achievements in the world. The A40 conquers extreme mountain terrain, the Paris ring road transformed an entire capital city, and the A10 stretches an extraordinary 557 kilometres from Paris to Bordeaux. Explore the record-breaking construction feats, breathtaking structures, and ingenious solutions that make these roads truly remarkable.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: Until recently, Portugal’s traditional ewe’s milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programme.desc: The remaining nine bakers must think beyond the bar as they create a nougat-filled chocolate confection in a surprising shape as they vie for the coveted Golden Whisk.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese And Special Sauce
programme.desc: Rachael is cooking up some serious comfort food today and with this much flavour, you'd never guess that these robust bull's eye burgers topped with onions and blue cheese sauce are plant-based.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt teams up with wine connoisseur Adam Walls to complement his specialty Lo Mai Gai. Laura and Chef Jack Ingram create a decadent chocolate plum clafoutis at Jolley's Boathouse in Adelaide, while Mike ventures to Taggerty, Victoria, to prepare wood cooked bananas for a local celebrity.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminds everyone to make the kitchen and recipe work for you. Lidia starts with a one-sheet wonder of Spicy Pork Chops & Broccoli.

programme.title: What Chefs Want
programme.desc: Chef Damian D'Silva uncovers the fascinating history and medicinal properties of Singapore's traditional cuisine. From the healing power of ginger to the time-honoured recipes of Peranakan cuisine.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Mostaccioli owe their name to one of the ingredients they are made with: grape must (mosto). These days, this elusive ingredient has been replaced with a combination of cocoa, spices and vincotto.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight's is all about the glorious tomato, with Guy joining tomato grower John Monigatti on Echuca's black soil plains during harvest. Maeve then shares tomato day with a large Calabrese clan - the Cipri family in suburban Sydney who have made fresh tomato sauce every year since the patriarch Severio arrived in Australia 45 years ago.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: The most sacred food of the Anishinaabe people has become a prized ingredient in the upper Midwest and beyond.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.desc: Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where culinary masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culminates in art.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight, Guy visits dedicated Melbourne artisan baker Daniel Chirico and tastes bread straight from the oven. Guy then demonstrates a delicious bread-based salad called panzanella. Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: Pears got their start in Oregon back in 1847 when an Iowa native brought the fruit to the region. In 2005, the Oregon legislature named the pear the state fruit.

programme.desc: Justine shows you how to make a classic steak diane and her mixed fettucini with asparagus and egg. Alvin Quah shares his recipe for pork san choy bao.

programme.desc: It's a night of smokey goodness as Adam, chef Tom Sarafian and comedian Tegan Higginbotham share how they like to savour smokey flavours.

programme.desc: Anna offers two innovative takes on classic meatball dishes: tuna meatballs served with an aioli dipping sauce and eggplant meatballs paired with spicy marinara and topped with ricotta salata.

Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari

Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.desc: Justine shows you how to make a classic steak diane and her mixed fettucini with asparagus and egg. Alvin Quah shares his recipe for pork san choy bao.

programme.title: Record-breaking Highways

Explore the record-breaking construction feats, breathtaking structures, and ingenious solutions that make these roads truly remarkable.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese And Special Sauce
programme.desc: Rachael is cooking up some serious comfort food today and with this much flavour, you'd never guess that these robust bull's eye burgers topped with onions and blue cheese sauce are plant-based.

programme.desc: Matt teams up with wine connoisseur Adam Walls to complement his specialty Lo Mai Gai. Laura and Chef Jack Ingram create a decadent chocolate plum clafoutis at Jolley's Boathouse in Adelaide, while Mike ventures to Taggerty, Victoria, to prepare wood cooked bananas for a local celebrity.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminds everyone to make the kitchen and recipe work for you. Lidia starts with a one-sheet wonder of Spicy Pork Chops & Broccoli.

programme.title: What Chefs Want
programme.desc: Chef Damian D'Silva uncovers the fascinating history and medicinal properties of Singapore's traditional cuisine. From the healing power of ginger to the time-honoured recipes of Peranakan cuisine.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Mostaccioli owe their name to one of the ingredients they are made with: grape must (mosto). These days, this elusive ingredient has been replaced with a combination of cocoa, spices and vincotto.

programme.desc: Tonight's is all about the glorious tomato, with Guy joining tomato grower John Monigatti on Echuca's black soil plains during harvest. Maeve then shares tomato day with a large Calabrese clan - the Cipri family in suburban Sydney who have made fresh tomato sauce every year since the patriarch Severio arrived in Australia 45 years ago.

programme.title: America The Bountiful

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass

Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.desc: Pears got their start in Oregon back in 1847 when an Iowa native brought the fruit to the region. In 2005, the Oregon legislature named the pear the state fruit.

programme.desc: Justine shows you how to make a classic steak diane and her mixed fettucini with asparagus and egg. Alvin Quah shares his recipe for pork san choy bao.

Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.title: The Orator

Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice

The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: Hope Springs
programme.desc: A woman (Meryl Streep) drags her sceptical husband (Tommy Lee Jones) to a renowned counselor's (Steve Carell) marriage retreat to try to put the spark back in their relationship.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully-fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. Directed by Alex Garland, starring Rory Kinnear, Jessie Buckley, Paapa Essiedu.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Tunnel (part 2)
programme.desc: In 1961 Berlin, as the Wall rises, Harry escapes East Germany but his sister Lotte is trapped. He leads a risky tunnel-digging rescue beneath the border, racing guards to secure freedom for them all.

programme.title: Man Who Didn't Want To See The Titanic
programme.desc: Jaakko and Sirpa have never met face to face but they talk on the phone every day. When he hears about her declining health, he decides to go meet her in another city; a challenge if you can't see and are paralysed from the chest down.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: The Take
programme.desc: When pickpocket Michael steals the wrong bag in Paris, he's s hunted by the CIA. Agent Sean Briar sees him as a key asset in exposing a major conspiracy, and the two race against time to stop it.

programme.title: Notes On A Scandal
programme.desc: A veteran high school teacher befriends a younger art teacher, who is having an affair with one of her 15-year-old students. However, her intentions with this new 'friend' also go well beyond platonic friendship. Stars Cate Blanchett, Judi Dench and Andrew Simpson.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.sub-title: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese And Special Sauce
programme.desc: Rachael is cooking up some serious comfort food today and with this much flavour, you'd never guess that these robust bull's eye burgers topped with onions and blue cheese sauce are plant-based.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminds everyone to make the kitchen and recipe work for you. Lidia starts with a one-sheet wonder of Spicy Pork Chops & Broccoli.

programme.title: What Chefs Want

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Mostaccioli owe their name to one of the ingredients they are made with: grape must (mosto). These days, this elusive ingredient has been replaced with a combination of cocoa, spices and vincotto.

programme.title: America The Bountiful

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari

Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.desc: Pears got their start in Oregon back in 1847 when an Iowa native brought the fruit to the region. In 2005, the Oregon legislature named the pear the state fruit.

programme.desc: Justine shows you how to make a classic steak diane and her mixed fettucini with asparagus and egg. Alvin Quah shares his recipe for pork san choy bao.

programme.desc: It's a night of smokey goodness as Adam, chef Tom Sarafian and comedian Tegan Higginbotham share how they like to savour smokey flavours.

programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.title: What Chefs Want
programme.sub-title: Art And Storytelling Of Food, The
programme.desc: Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where culinary masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culminates in art.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight, Guy visits dedicated Melbourne artisan baker Daniel Chirico and tastes bread straight from the oven. Guy then demonstrates a delicious bread-based salad called panzanella. Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.title: America The Bountiful

programme.sub-title: Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania
programme.desc: Will journeys to Italy’s picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk. programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek take a tour around the historic ghost town of Joadja and help with the distilling process with the Jimenez family. Like Derek, Valero doesn't drink - an interesting challenge for a head distiller. At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael teaches us how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce, served alongside potato salad with broccolini and fresh cherry tomatoes.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Matt cooks up a Filipino-inspired Pork Adobo, Laura savours cold soba noodles with Japanese Chef Kinsan, and Mike indulges with poached salmon and watercress salad. Plus, Matt shares his family's secret midweek ingredient pizza dough recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia shares recipes that will be recreated for generations. Growing up, Lidia loved foraging for dandelions, and her Dandelion & Chickpea Salad is a great way to try them!

programme.title: What Chefs Want
programme.sub-title: Art And Storytelling Of Food, The
programme.desc: Enter the mesmerizing world of food art, where culinary masterpieces are created with equal parts skill and creativity. Chef Janice Wong takes Sally on a chocolate-making journey that culminates in art.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: When Silvia thinks back to her childhood in Italy, most of her core memories are associated with food moments.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight, Guy visits dedicated Melbourne artisan baker Daniel Chirico and tastes bread straight from the oven. Guy then demonstrates a delicious bread-based salad called panzanella. Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.title: America The Bountiful

programme.sub-title: Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania
programme.desc: Will journeys to Italy’s picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk.
